description: List the screens (top-level frames) in a Figma file, with their size and whether the project already has them: new, imported, or changed in Figma since. layernote reads the file with the user’s own Figma connection in layernote, not with a Figma connector in this chat. The project must be a Figma design project. Use it to pick frames for import_figma_frames. A big file gives up to 200 at a time: narrow it with `search`.

fileUrl.description: The Figma file’s link, as Figma copies it (File, Copy link)

project.description: The project, by name or id from list_projects. Only needed when the token reaches several projects

search.description: Only the frames whose name holds this, e.g. "checkout"

name: list_figma_frames
title: List the frames in a Figma file
